problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $X$ has the cumulative distribution function $F(x)$ shown in the table below, compute $P(1<X\le 3).$

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $F(x)$ | $\frac{3}{20}$ | $\frac{7}{20}$ | $\frac{11}{20}$ | $\frac{17}{20}$ | $1$ |

$P(1<X\le 3)=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

To compute the probability of a random variable $X$ over an interval, we can use the rule

$$
P(a<X\le b)=F(b)-F(a).
$$

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(1<X\le 3) & =F(3)-F(1) \\  & =\frac{17}{20}-\frac{7}{20} \\  & =\frac{10}{20} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
